text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Swan S. has arrived. I step inside the waiting room, only to find Hishi Akebono crouched down on all fours.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hang back for a moment. Her movements are fluid as she rinses out her mouth and scatters salt on the floor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, she stands on her tiptoes, widens her stance, and crouches. Then, she stands tall, crouches again, and thrusts her arms before her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Phew! All right! I'm gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm, well… I was copying a ritual!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Have you seen it done before? Sumo wrestlers carry out the same ritual before matches.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Purifying their bodies and the wrestling ring is like their way of saying that they'll have a good, clean match.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I don't know why, but my jitters are way worse than usual today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I just can't sit still knowing the race is about to start, so I did the ritual to help calm my nerves.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And guess what? I feel ready to go now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Maybe the ritual gave me some sumo powers, but I feel like I can do some really incredible pivot throws today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've never seen Hishi Akebono this ready to race as the curtain rises on the Swan S!
